operator.reverse: Y -> platform/sensor geometry -> estimate X -> backpropagate H_path -> residual H_target -> stationary-focus test -> fingerprint controls -> withheld forward replay
operator.objective: Treat the observed sound as already transformed by an unknown target and ask what stationary target transfer function, if any, is required to explain it.

key_physics: For direct monostatic ranging to one stationary point, platform motion alone bounds the apparent direct-path range rate by the platform radial speed.
A target transfer function can reshape spectrum, phase and impulse response and can add ringing/group delay, but a time-invariant delay is a fixed range bias rather than sustained apparent velocity.

A moving apparent contact can arise without a moving solid target only if the dominant propagation/scattering locus changes with time, for example multipath switching, extended/distributed scattering or track association changes.

case_results.lesson_for_cousteau: A coherent and apparently geometric acoustic boundary can be created by a spatially distributed biological layer.
Highly regular pulse trains and harmonics can remain mysterious for decades without implying a structure or vehicle.
Reported apparent responsiveness to a submarine is not sufficient; the first discriminator is whether the acoustic focus follows deployed sensor geometry or a fixed seafloor coordinate.

cross_case_result.highest_value_archive_target: 1980s ballistic-missile-submarine raw sonar account discussed by Gallaudet

new_gate.question: Can an apparent moving sonar track be better explained by a stationary/distributed target transfer function plus propagation than by a physical moving target?
minimum_inputs: ping times and waveform or passive reference
new_gate.pass_condition: After propagation correction and time-reversal/matched-field backpropagation, at least three independent segments or passes refocus to one Earth-fixed locus within propagated uncertainty and preserve a repeatable target-specific transfer function that beats biological, reverberation and ASW-system controls.
new_gate.fail_condition: Recovered focus moves with the reported contact, sonobuoy/transmitter geometry, biological layer or processing association rather than remaining fixed.
